majors.issue: The same water-tower compound is reused in both shanty seeds: concrete pad + rust water tower + campfire ring + teal-roof stall stacked over the blue counter + signboard. The layout is identical pixel for pixel; only the position on the map changes. This is the 'shared water-tower compound' defect again, moved from settlement to shanty, and it makes the two seeds read as one stamp.
majors.fix: Build the compound from a per-seed pool (tower position/side, stall vs counter, pad shape), or use the tower compound in only one shanty seed and give the other a different focal point (scrap-wall market, rain catcher, bus-shell hall).

majors.issue: Identical stamps still sit near each other. Shanty-3 repeats the red corrugated shack 5+ times; two copies stand on the same row (~x370-415 and ~x515-560, y225-270). Shanty-6 puts two identical red shacks touching side by side (~x35-125, y275-320). Settlement-1 compound: two identical wrecked-car+tyre piles side by side on the top fence line, two identical caravan husks stacked on the right, two identical flanking shacks. Settlement-1 roads: two identical blue sedans on the same E-W road and two identical green trucks on the N-S road. Ruined-city-2 has two identical blue sedans on one avenue (~x280 and ~x695, y210-230); ruined-city-5 has two blue sedans and two green trucks in the same plaza.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r7-A/s1-comp.png (top tyre wrecks at crop x220/x420, y40; right husks at y240/y500), /tmp/vqa-r7-A/s1-road.png (blue cars at x850/x1260), shanty-6 overview lower-left, ruined-city-5 overview centre plaza
majors.fix: Add a minimum-distance / no-repeat-within-N-cells rule per sprite id, and add colour or damage variants for cars and shacks (flip is not enough). Never place the same shack id adjacent.

majors.issue: Every vine block still ends in a single golden/ochre cell at the right end of its bottom row. All six blocks across both seeds do this, so it reads as an end-cap artefact (the 'lone golden cell' from last round), not ripe grapes.
majors.fix: Remove the golden end cell, or scatter ripe variants inside rows at low density so no block corner always gets one.

majors.issue: The mine adit is still a free-standing stone arch on flat packed dirt in both seeds. There is no hillside, spoil heap or rock face behind it, so it reads as a doorway to nowhere / a toy shed. Mining-2 also repeats the same boulder-cluster sprite three times around it.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r7-A/m7-yard.png (adit crop x660-790,y340-480), /tmp/vqa-r7-A/m2-yard.png (adit x410-550,y190-335; three identical boulder piles at x230,y260 / x610,y260 / x560,y500)
majors.fix: Seat the adit into a rock-face or terrace back (cliff piece or spoil mound behind and beside it), or place the yard against an existing terrace. Use distinct rock variants.

minors.issue: The compound is still roughly left/right mirrored: shack-bighouse-shack row, fence halves with a central gap top and bottom, and matching tyre-wreck pairs. Only the water towers break the symmetry.
minors.fix: Offset the gate, vary the fence run lengths, and put different props per side.

minors.issue: The flagstone plaza is fully intact, with a continuous crisp curb around the whole outline. It is aged by bushes and debris, but it still has no missing slabs or earth gaps, so it reads more as a restored patio than a ruin.
minors.fix: Punch a few slab holes showing dirt or grass, and break the curb in 2-3 places.

minors.issue: The roofed temple's interior between the columns shows the plaza crazy-paving at the same scale and brightness, so it reads as see-through rather than as a shaded cella.
minors.fix: Darken or shade the interior floor, or add a back-wall band.

minors.issue: A pale square patch sits on the paving near the centre-left, and the temple's upper-left roof looks washed out / semi-transparent.
minors.fix: Check the alpha on the weathering overlay; give the worn-slab piece a defined edge.

minors.issue: The props keep the same relative arrangement in both seeds: barrel rack upper-right, press below it, grape crates right of the press.
minors.fix: Randomise the prop cluster order and side.

minors.issue: A green truck is parked half on the sidewalk / block edge.
minors.fix: Snap vehicles fully onto the road interior.

minors.issue: Shanty towns and settlement-4 share the same shack/tent set scattered on bare dirt; only the road treatment differs. The types are weakly distinct.
minors.fix: Give the shanty its own vocabulary: dense lean-to clusters, tarp walkways, scrap walls.

minors.issue: The irregular S-shaped brown pothole reads a little like a worm or dirt smear at 1x. It is acceptable but weaker than pothole-a.
minors.fix: Make the shape more compact and give the far rim a darker shadowed lip.
